purpose: Option 1 of the orientation question (a global rule fixed on the training split): do one-sided training reports agree with the image half that holds the ground-truth lesion? Preparation only; the supervisor has not chosen an option. Validation data are not read.

data.ids: lgms.data.split_ids('QaTa-COV19', 'train'); assert no intersection with split_ids('QaTa-COV19', 'val') and split_ids('QaTa-COV19', 'test') (test: id list only)
data.masks: lgms.data.read_mask('QaTa-COV19', 'train', id) (ground truth of the training split only)
data.report_location: results/phase2_text_attributes.csv rows with dataset == 'QaTa-COV19' and split == 'train' (Phase 2 parse, not re-parsed); every training id must have exactly one row
data.grid: common 224 x 224 array; image-right half = columns 112-223 (as in configs/phase4/stage0_spec.json)

exclusions.mask_empty: the ground-truth mask has no lesion pixel
exclusions.not_one_sided: the location names both sides or no side
exclusions.counting: each excluded report is counted once, under the first reason in this order

one_sided: the location names only 'left' or only 'right' (any zones, 'unspecified' included: only the side is needed)

lesion_side.fraction: f = lesion pixels in columns 112-223 / all lesion pixels
lesion_side.primary: f > 1/2 -> image right; f < 1/2 -> image left; f = 1/2 -> excluded and counted
lesion_side.robust: f >= 2/3 -> image right; f <= 1/3 -> image left; 1/3 < f < 2/3 -> excluded and counted

conventions.A: patient left on image right (spec value 'patient_left_on_image_right'): a left report agrees if the lesion side is image right, a right report if image left
conventions.B: patient left on image left (spec value 'patient_left_on_image_left'): a left report agrees if the lesion side is image left, a right report if image right
conventions.agreement: one-sided reports whose lesion side matches the convention / one-sided reports with a lesion side (after the exclusions of the definition in use)

groups.other: neither prefix: counted in 'all' only and described separately; not used in rules 1-3 and 5
groups.all_by_side: within 'all': left-only reports and right-only reports separately (rule 4)
groups.sub_by_view: within 'sub': 'vp-ap', 'vp-pa', no view token; descriptive only

wilson: Wilson score interval, 95%, z = 1.959963984540054; lower bound = (p + z^2/(2n) - z*sqrt(p(1-p)/n + z^2/(4n^2))) / (1 + z^2/n)

rules.1: the same convention has the higher agreement (strictly > the other) in all, sub and covid
rules.2: that convention has agreement >= 0.90 in all, sub and covid
rules.3: that convention has a Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.85 in all, sub and covid
rules.4: in 'all', the agreement of that convention is >= 0.85 for left-only reports and >= 0.85 for right-only reports
rules.5: sub and covid each have >= 30 one-sided reports with a lesion side; otherwise the overall result is 'insufficient sample'
rules.6: with the robust lesion-side definition, rules 1-5 have the same truth values and the same winning convention as with the primary definition
rules.7: sub-* by patient (patient id from src/phase2/texts.py groups()): each patient votes by the majority of its one-sided reports (agree / disagree with the winning convention, primary definition); patients with a tie are excluded and counted; patient-level agreement >= 0.90

interpretations.winning_convention: the convention named by rule 1 (primary definition); if rule 1 fails there is no winner and rules 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 are false
interpretations.rule_5_counts: reports with a lesion side under the primary definition; for rule 6 the robust counts are used

result.fail: rule 5 is true and any other rule is false

stop_conditions: training ids overlap validation or test ids; this file changes after its commit; parse_ok is false for more than 5% of the QaTa training rows; any unit test fails; any mask or text outside the training split would be needed
output: results/phase4_option1_train_orientation.csv (group labels and numbers only; no text, no per-image rows)
